caption:
Here's why negatives flip the inequality sign.

2 < 5, but −2 > −5. Multiplying by a negative mirrors the number line, so the order reverses.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Here's why negatives flip the inequality sign: 2 < 5, but −2 > −5.

youtube.title: Why the Inequality Flips When You Divide by a Negative
youtube.description: Multiplying or dividing by a negative mirrors numbers across zero, so their order reverses. Example: −3x + 4 > 19 gives x < −5.
